summary: IQM Quantum Computers Oyj filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its Q3 and first-nine-months 2026 interim report, press release and FY2026 guidance, the US-equivalent of a foreign private issuer's periodic earnings disclosure. No transaction, stake, price or premium is involved. Operationally, Q3 bookings were EUR 42.2 million, lifting year-to-date order intake to EUR 52.9 million, with backlog of EUR 102.5 million at September 30, 2026, up 52% year to date; Q3 revenue rose 51% year over year to EUR 8.9 million, cash was EUR 260.4 million, and full-year guidance was reaffirmed. No board recommendation, advisor, structural mechanics or regulatory clock applies; there is no risk-arb angle.
